description: RxGraph evaluation dataset — 30 labeled cases covering known interactions, brand-name resolution, multi-drug queries, low-interaction baselines, unrecognized drug handling, and edge cases. Cases are grounded in FDA-documented interactions between seed drugs in the RxGraph corpus.

assertion_schema.normalized_drugs_include: [str] All listed generic names must appear in result.normalized_drugs
assertion_schema.unrecognized_drugs_include: [str] All listed names must appear in result.unrecognized_drugs
assertion_schema.unrecognized_drugs_empty: bool — result.unrecognized_drugs must be empty when true
assertion_schema.interaction_pairs_include: [[str,str]] Each pair must appear in graph_query_results (order-insensitive). Data-dependent: may fail if edge not yet loaded in Neo4j.
assertion_schema.risk_level_in: [str] report.risk_level must be one of these values
assertion_schema.sources_nonempty: bool — report.sources must be non-empty when true
assertion_schema.report_not_null: bool — report must not be None when true
assertion_schema.min_interaction_count: int — len(graph_query_results) must be >= this value
assertion_schema.interaction_count_is_zero: bool — graph_query_results must be empty when true
assertion_schema.no_crash: bool — agent must return a result dict without raising an exception

categories.known_interaction: Drug pairs with well-established, FDA-documented interactions. Primary test of retrieval coverage.
categories.brand_name: Queries using brand names instead of generic names. Tests RxNorm entity normalization.
categories.multi_drug: Queries with 3 or more drugs. Tests pairwise interaction coverage at scale.
categories.low_interaction: Drug pairs with no known major interaction. Tests false positive rate.
categories.unrecognized_drug: Queries containing invented or misspelled drug names. Tests refusal and graceful degradation.
categories.edge_case: Single drug, no drugs, or non-drug queries. Tests robustness of entity extraction.

cases.description: Warfarin + aspirin: major bleeding risk from anticoagulant + NSAID platelet inhibition
cases.note: One of the most well-documented drug interactions in FDA labeling. Both are seed drugs.

input.query: Can I take warfarin with aspirin?

cases.description: Warfarin + ibuprofen: major NSAID-anticoagulant interaction with GI bleeding risk
cases.note: NSAIDs increase GI bleeding risk and some inhibit CYP2C9, warfarin's primary metabolizer.

input.query: Is it safe to take ibuprofen while on warfarin?

cases.description: Warfarin + naproxen: NSAID-anticoagulant interaction, same mechanism as ibuprofen
cases.note: All non-selective NSAIDs carry this interaction. Tests coverage beyond the most common pairs.

input.query: I take warfarin. Can I use naproxen for pain?

cases.description: Warfarin + fluconazole: major CYP2C9 inhibition significantly increases warfarin exposure
cases.note: Fluconazole is a potent CYP2C9 inhibitor. FDA explicitly warns this combination requires dose adjustment.

input.query: What happens if I take warfarin and fluconazole together?

cases.description: Warfarin + amiodarone: major, amiodarone inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 raising warfarin levels substantially
cases.note: Well-documented major interaction. Amiodarone's long half-life (weeks) makes management difficult.

input.query: Drug interactions between warfarin and amiodarone

cases.description: Warfarin + metronidazole: metronidazole inhibits CYP2C9 and warfarin stereoselective metabolism
cases.note: FDA label for metronidazole explicitly warns of increased anticoagulant effect.

input.query: Can I take metronidazole with warfarin?

cases.description: Fluoxetine + phenelzine: contraindicated serotonin syndrome risk (SSRI + MAOI)
cases.note: FDA black box warning on both drugs. Concurrent SSRI and MAOI use is contraindicated.

input.query: Interactions between fluoxetine and phenelzine

cases.description: Sertraline + tramadol: serotonin syndrome and lowered seizure threshold
cases.note: Tramadol has serotonergic activity. Combination with SSRIs increases serotonin syndrome risk.

input.query: Should I be worried about taking sertraline and tramadol at the same time?

cases.description: Simvastatin + clarithromycin: major rhabdomyolysis risk from CYP3A4 inhibition
cases.note: FDA label for simvastatin explicitly contraindicates clarithromycin. CYP3A4 inhibition dramatically raises statin exposure.

input.query: Can simvastatin be taken with clarithromycin?

cases.description: Simvastatin + ketoconazole: major rhabdomyolysis risk, ketoconazole is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor
cases.note: Ketoconazole is one of the strongest CYP3A4 inhibitors. FDA warns of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis.

input.query: Is there an interaction between simvastatin and ketoconazole?

cases.description: Digoxin + amiodarone: amiodarone inhibits renal digoxin clearance leading to toxicity
cases.note: Digoxin has a narrow therapeutic index. Amiodarone can increase digoxin levels by 50-100%. FDA-documented major interaction.

input.query: What is the interaction between digoxin and amiodarone?

cases.description: Lithium + ibuprofen: NSAIDs reduce renal lithium clearance causing toxicity
cases.note: Lithium has a narrow therapeutic index. NSAIDs can increase lithium levels by 25–50%. FDA-documented.

input.query: Can someone on lithium take ibuprofen?

cases.description: Brand names 'Advil' (ibuprofen) and 'Coumadin' (warfarin) should normalize to generic names
cases.note: Tests RxNorm brand-to-generic resolution for two well-known brand names. Interaction should be found after normalization.

input.query: Can I take Advil with Coumadin?

cases.description: Brand names 'Prozac' (fluoxetine) and 'Nardil' (phenelzine) should resolve to generics
cases.note: Both are brand names of seed drugs. Normalization must succeed to find the contraindicated SSRI+MAOI combination.

input.query: Interactions between Prozac and Nardil

cases.description: Brand names 'Zocor' (simvastatin) and 'Biaxin' (clarithromycin) should normalize correctly
cases.note: Tests resolution of two brand names that form a major CYP3A4 interaction pair.

input.query: Is Zocor safe to take with Biaxin?

cases.description: Brand name 'Lanoxin' (digoxin) mixed with generic 'amiodarone' in the same query
cases.note: Tests partial brand-name queries: one brand name, one generic. Normalization must work for mixed inputs.

input.query: I take Lanoxin and amiodarone — are there interactions?

cases.description: Brand name 'Zoloft' (sertraline) with generic ibuprofen: SSRI + NSAID bleeding risk
cases.note: SSRIs combined with NSAIDs increase GI bleeding risk. Tests partial brand-name input.

input.query: Can I take Zoloft and ibuprofen together?

cases.description: Three-drug query: warfarin + aspirin + ibuprofen — all three have pairwise interactions
cases.note: Tests pairwise detection across 3 drugs. At minimum, warfarin-aspirin and warfarin-ibuprofen pairs must be found.

input.query: I take warfarin. Is it safe to take both aspirin and ibuprofen?

cases.description: Three serotonergic drugs: fluoxetine + tramadol + phenelzine
cases.note: Multiple serotonin-increasing agents across classes. The fluoxetine-phenelzine pair must be caught at minimum.

input.query: Interactions between fluoxetine, tramadol, and phenelzine

cases.description: Simvastatin with two CYP inhibitors: clarithromycin + fluconazole
cases.note: Both inhibitors compound statin toxicity risk. Tests detection when multiple drugs interact with one target drug.

input.query: I'm on simvastatin and was prescribed both clarithromycin and fluconazole

cases.description: Warfarin + aspirin + metformin — metformin is pharmacologically neutral to this pair
cases.note: Tests that adding a neutral drug does not suppress detection of the warfarin-aspirin interaction, and does not generate false interactions with metformin.

input.query: I take warfarin, aspirin, and metformin — any interactions?

cases.description: Metformin + lisinopril: no well-known major pharmacokinetic interaction
cases.note: Common combination in diabetic hypertension. System should not hallucinate a major interaction. Failure here indicates false positives.

input.query: Do metformin and lisinopril interact?

cases.description: Acetaminophen + amlodipine: no known direct pharmacokinetic interaction
cases.note: Acetaminophen is generally preferred over NSAIDs in hypertensive patients. Should show no major interaction.

input.query: Is it safe to take acetaminophen with amlodipine?

cases.description: Rosuvastatin + metformin: no significant direct interaction
cases.note: Rosuvastatin is not CYP3A4-metabolized, making it safer than simvastatin for CYP inhibitor combinations. Tests statin-specific coverage.

input.query: Can I take rosuvastatin and metformin together?

cases.description: Omeprazole + atenolol: limited direct pharmacokinetic interaction expected
cases.note: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19; atenolol is primarily renally excreted without significant CYP involvement. Tests false positive for common polypharmacy.

input.query: I take omeprazole and atenolol — are there any interactions?

cases.description: One completely invented drug name 'xyzopril' combined with real 'warfarin'
cases.note: System must recognize warfarin and flag xyzopril as unrecognized. Must not fabricate an interaction involving the fake drug.

input.query: Interactions between xyzopril and warfarin

cases.description: Both drug names are completely invented — system must not fabricate interactions
cases.note: Tests refusal behavior: when no drugs are recognized, no interactions should be returned.

input.query: Can I take fakeacillin with blubberone?

cases.description: Misspelled drug name 'warafin' (correct: warfarin) combined with aspirin
cases.note: Valid outcomes: (a) RxNorm approximate match resolves 'warafin' to warfarin and the interaction is found, OR (b) 'warafin' appears in unrecognized_drugs. Either is acceptable. System must not crash.

input.query: Can I take warafin with aspirin?

cases.description: Single drug 'warfarin' with no second drug — no pairwise interaction possible
cases.note: System should recognize warfarin, find no interaction pair, and return gracefully with risk_level 'none'.

input.query: Tell me about warfarin interactions

cases.description: No drug names present in query — general health question without specific medications
cases.note: System must not hallucinate drug names or interactions. Entity extraction should return empty lists.

input.query: What is a good diet for high blood pressure?
